meaning: Before the words: the object that the whole song is about.
visualConcept: A glint spins up into a gold hoop at the centre of frame (Y-axis spin, 7 half-turns easing out).
transitionOut: The hoop stays put; the next lyric is built around it.

lyrics: Her love is in your head.
meaning: She is all he thinks about.
visualConcept: The hoop is the o in "love"; a one-line profile draws itself around the words and the hoop turns out to be hanging from its earlobe.
semanticMetaphor: earring = the thought she left behind
typographyTreatment: Instrument Serif italic 250px with the hoop as a letter; function words tiny
motion: line art stroke-draws over 2.2s; pendulum swing on the hoop
transitionOut: On "You lost" the hoop is nudged, drops off the ear, and the camera falls with it.

lyrics: You lost your earrings in her bed.
meaning: The physical evidence, left at her place.
visualConcept: Camera tilts from night into ivory silk sheets; two hoops land with hard metallic bounces on "earrings", letters of "earrings" drop and bounce like the metal.
motion: gravity + decaying bounces; silk breathes slowly; window light leak
transitionOut: A fold shadow slides over the pair; camera pushes into the dark crease, where a phone wakes.

lyrics: You couldn't tell her that you lost them
visualConcept: Full-bleed iMessage thread to "her" (avatar = the hoop). The lyric is typed in the field in sync with the vocal, mirrored large in serif, with live keyboard key pops.

lyrics: 'cause you're scared and you're not talking.
visualConcept: Panic backspace deletes the message; SCARED (the only Anton in the film) punches in with chromatic split and tremble; her typing bubble appears and vanishes on "talking".

lyrics: So you think of what to say
visualConcept: Ghost drafts typed and deleted in the field: "hey", "random question but", "i think i left my earrings at yours".

lyrics: and save it for another day.
visualConcept: "save" collapses the draft into a Saved to Drafts toast whose spinner is the hoop; on "another day" the date stamp flips forward day after day; the screen locks to black glass.

lyrics: 'Cause you just never had the heart.
visualConcept: A gold earring wire draws a heart around "heart." and stops 14% short of closing: a heart that never completes.
transitionOut: The heart splits at its cleft.

lyrics: Now they just drift further apart from you.
meaning: The relationship (and the earrings) slip away.
visualConcept: The two lobes of the broken heart become two hoops drifting apart in dark space; "drift" leaves a motion trail, "further" tracks out, "ap|art" tears in two, "from you." is left alone; camera pulls back.
transitionOut: One hoop rushes into frame on "Oh".

visualConcept: The hoop becomes the O of a 560px "Oh." with gold halation and a light leak; title card; final glint; fade.
